summary: Global Business Travel Group, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 2.02 and 9.01 to disclose its Q1 2026 earnings results via a press release. Revenue was $840M (up 35% YoY), net income $54M, and Adjusted EBITDA $150M. The filing is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is described. This is a standard current report of operating results, with no structural or event-driven corporate action.
